metadata.name: int_orders_aggregated_from_items
metadata.comment:
Order-grain rollup from enriched order items.
View Text: (
    with src as (
  select * from sujeet_data_analytics_workspace.silver_dev.int_order_items_enriched
),

agg as (
  select
      order_id,
      user_id,
      min(item_created_at)           as order_first_item_at,
      count(*)                       as item_count,
      sum(coalesce(sale_price, 0.0)) as items_gross_revenue
  from src
  group by 1,2
)

select * from agg
  )
View Schema Mode: COMPENSATION
View Catalog and Namespace: sujeet_data_analytics_workspace.default
View Query Output Columns: [`order_id`, `user_id`, `order_first_item_at`, `item_count`, `items_gross_revenue`]
